sources.title: ApplicationExitInfo user-requested process termination
sources.note: ApplicationExitInfo.REASON_USER_REQUESTED is public since API30, constant10, includes user-directed termination such as removing an app from Recents. P0-S2 shell exit-history reason10 contextualizes one last-window close; shell subreason22 REMOVE TASK is an observed diagnostic, not a public app API. No guarantee of final Activity/cleanup callbacks. Android/platform owner; fallback is unknown exit and previously committed state. App-side accessor use remains unimplemented/unqualified.

sources.title: Android local network permission
sources.note: Runtime37 and target37+ require ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK for direct LAN access. Covers TCP/UDP/library/WebView traffic; denial may appear as timeout. System-mediated service picker is a separate documented route. No grant or network test performed.

sources.title: Manifest local network permission reference
sources.note: Manifest.permission.ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK addedAPI37, dangerous; value android.permission.ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK. Reference defines local network on broadcast-capable Wi-Fi/Ethernet and excludes cellular/VPN; do not generalize LAN results to VPN routes. Constant presence/value independently checked in selected SDK37.0 android.jar; no app grant/device pass.
